## Validation and limits

Relative recall was **9/9 (100%) against the development set** of screened records; this is not independent validation or an estimate of absolute sensitivity. The chemotherapy and early-stage blocks were tested and left out: their latest 30-record loss samples found no eligible records, and they would reduce the result set by about 47% and 73%, respectively. Those criteria should be applied during screening.

A checkpoint category probe found one eligible case report (PMID 32914041) outside the earlier wording; I added PD-L1/PD-1 blockade terms, and the current strategy retrieves it. The probe budget was exhausted, so residual coverage uncertainty remains. The supplied criteria did not exclude case reports.

This draft still needs **PRESS peer review by an information specialist** before use. The internal critic was PRESS-structured, not specialist peer review.
